entities.name: Bernhard Häring
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bernard Häring was a German moral theologian and a Redemptorist priest in the Catholic Church. The national Catholic Reporter, upon his death, called him "the foremost Catholic moral theologian of the 20th century and a leading advocate for church reform before, during and after the Second Vatican Council."
